current_activity: the division, with the 2d and 97th Infantry Divisions, enters Pilsen and the shooting war ends for the V Corps
notes: Event date: 6 May 1945 (Last Offensive ch. 19 p. 467: on 6 May men of the 2d and 97th Divisions and a new unit, the 16th Armored Division, passed through the infantry on the highway to Pilsen and "the armor raced into Pilsen" past the antiaircraft guns of the Skoda works; CMH ETO-OB command-post list of the 16th Armored Division: Pilsen on 6 May 45; Wikipedia, Plzeň: the city was liberated on 6 May 1945 by the 16th Armored Division of the Third Army, with elements of the 97th and 2d Infantry Divisions). Event definition: the division enters the city and its command post is listed there the same day; the V Corps had passed to the Third Army on 4 May. Relationship: V Corps unspecified_subordination (from 6 May 45, CMH table); Third Army assigned (from 17 Apr 45, CMH table); 12th Army Group assigned (from 29 Jan 45, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). The CMH table has a single corps column and does not say assigned or attached for a corps. Location: Pilsen (Plzeň) (CMH ETO-OB command-post list, R572 p. 550: listed 6 May 1945); the town centre stands for the command post. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Plzeň. Event support: good (the Green Book, Wikipedia and the CMH list agree on the day, the unit and the city). Location support: moderate (command post listed on the date).
